subject: planner,executor: fix join resolveIndex won't find its column from children schema & amend join's lused and rused logic for reversed column ref from join schema to its children (#51203)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent within planner/executor scope. The PhysicalHashJoin schema index resolution no longer assumes output schema is ordered relative to merged child schema, and executor join inline-projection now preserves per-child used-column order via ordered index lists; the PruneColumns signature refactor appears mechanically consistent with updated call sites. No remaining Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics issues found; later upstream/master retains the same hash-join ResolveIndices mapping approach (no subsequent fix indicating a regression here).
